entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to continue.
SUPPORT! And I swear if I get another robot I'm canceling everything!
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally, a person! Listen, Charlie, I want to return these awful cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's an issue of them being garbage! They've given me horrible blisters on my heels, and I can't get the cleats to feel right no matter what I do. I want a refund, and I want it now. Don't waste my time.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing you pain and not working out. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's 8675309. I've had them for a little while, but your policy says 90 days. If you try and deny this, I want your manager's name and I will be posting about this experience everywhere.
I understand your frustration, and I'll do everything I can to resolve this for you right now. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see the purchase was made 53 days ago.
That's right. So are you going to process my refund or do I need to escalate this?

There's no need to escalate, I can absolutely take care of this. You are correct, our return policy for these cycling shoes is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can start that return for a full refund for you immediately.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it? No fight?

Of course. I've just initiated the return authorization in our system. I am sending an email to you as we speak. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the shoes back to us. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Oh. Okay. Well... thank you. I appreciate you making that easy.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. The email just came through. Thanks again.
Perfect. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
